scope: Actual original FBX meshes combined by the production bridge solver/session and rendered by a Unity URP camera in one isolated batch project. No desktop or physical mouse/FPS claim.
checks: Default dedicated bridge commits from original source kit.
First bridge has a stable author identity.
Second differently sized bridge commits with an identity sorting before the first.
Saving a new earlier-sorting bridge does not overwrite the first bridge's persistent mesh assets.
Second bridge retains its distinct own geometry after scene save.
Duplicate-id fixture has an actual committed bridge before testing save validation.
Duplicate bridge identities are rejected before writing scene mesh assets.
Duplicate-id rejection preserves both existing bridge meshes.
